caption: The image is a drawing depicting a rectangular glass and wooden structure, resembling a glass coffin or case, with blue framing and decorative floral patterns in red and white on the frame and glass panels. Inside the structure, there is a human figure lying down, covered with a yellow, orange, and red blanket with stripes and patterns. The person's head, which is visible on the right side, is resting on a white pillow with a blue polka-dot design, and the hair is black with a red head covering. The figure's upper body is covered with an additional patterned cloth, and the hands are visible over the chest. The base of the structure features further decorative motifs in brown, orange, and blue, with stylized leaves and a central red flower. The background is plain and uncolored, with no other objects or elements in the image.
title: Plate 4: Christ in the Sepulchre: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
